sections.title: Player text
sections.body: Inside the village, the Co-op is a warm public room of tea steam, shoe lines, gift shelves, chipped mugs, and people deciding whether these travelers are guests, trouble, or both.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Run the Co-op as a social hub: shoe custom, regulars, games, tavern prompts, and trust-building.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "This is the room where Hush decides whether the party belongs for tonight. Offer shoes, food, a game, and one regular by description before name."
